ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ ٱلْقِسْمَةَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينُ فَٱرْزُقُوهُم مِّنْهُ وَقُولُوا۟ لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ ٱلْقِسْمَةَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينُ فَٱرْزُقُوهُم مِّنْهُ وَقُولُوا۟ لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا

ayahOccurrences.text: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَٰمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ۚ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمَ دِينًا ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِّإِثْمٍ ۙ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ ۚ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا شَهَٰدَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ حِينَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ ٱثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ آخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِى بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۙ وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَٰدَةَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْءَاثِمِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنَّهُمَا ٱسْتَحَقَّآ إِثْمًا فَآخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَوْلَيَٰنِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ لَشَهَٰدَتُنَآ أَحَقُّ مِن شَهَٰدَتِهِمَا وَمَا ٱعْتَدَيْنَآ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلْقِسْمَةَ is in the derivative form: قِسْمَةٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/س/م   q–s–m to divide, to partition, to share out
; portion, section; to divine, to seek to know the future, to ponder; to swear, oath; truce, allies; countenance, good looks, features; market place.

Of this root, 10 forms occur 33 times in the Qur’an:
قَسَمَ qasam 2 times; أَقْسَمَ ʾaqsama 20 times قَاسَمَ qāsama 1 time; تَقَاسَمَ taqāsama 1 time; يَسْتَقْسِم yastaqsim 1 time; قَسَم qasam 2 times; قِسْمَةٌ qismatun 3 times; مَقْسُوم maqsūm 1 time; مُقَسِّمات muqassimāt 1 time and مُقْتَسِمِين muqtasimın 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
قِسْمَةٌ qismatun [n.; v. n.] partition, dividing

(4:8) وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُو الْقُرْبَى وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهُ and if [other] kinfolk, orphans and the poor attend the division, make provision for them out of it [of the legacy].

entries.definitionHtml:

; portion, section; to divine, to seek to know the future, to ponder; to swear, oath; truce, allies; countenance, good looks, features; market place.

Of this root, 10 forms occur 33 times in the Qur’an:
قَسَمَ qasam 2 times; أَقْسَمَ ʾaqsama 20 times قَاسَمَ qāsama 1 time; تَقَاسَمَ taqāsama 1 time; يَسْتَقْسِم yastaqsim 1 time; قَسَم qasam 2 times; قِسْمَةٌ qismatun 3 times; مَقْسُوم maqsūm 1 time; مُقَسِّمات muqassimāt 1 time and مُقْتَسِمِين muqtasimın 1 time.

entries.label: قِسْمَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
قِسْمَةٌ qismatun [n.; v. n.] partition, dividing

(4:8) وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُو الْقُرْبَى وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهُ and if [other] kinfolk, orphans and the poor attend the division, make provision for them out of it [of the legacy].

entries.label: أَقْسَمَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَقْسَمَ ʾaqsama [v. IV, intrans.]

1 to swear

(5:107) فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِاللَّهِ لَشَهَادَتُنَا أَحَقُّ مِنْ شَهَادَتِهِمَا‏ let them swear by God, ‘Our testimony is more worthy [of being accepted] than theirs’

2 to vow, to resolve, to firmly decide on a course of action

(68:17) إِنَّا بَلَوْنَاهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ We tested them as We tested the owners of a garden, who vowed that they would harvest its fruits first thing in the morning.

entries.label: تَقَاسَمَ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَقَاسَمَ taqāsama [v. VI, intrans.] to swear to one another

(27:49) قَالُوا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ they said, ‘Swear to one another by God: we shall attack him and his household in the night.’

entries.label: قَاسَمَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَاسَمَ qāsama [v. III, trans.] to take a solemn oath; to exchange oaths

(7:21) وَقَاسَمَهُمَا إِنِّي لَكُمَا لَمِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ and he swore to them, (or, exchanged oaths with them,) ‘I am giving you sincere advice.’

entries.label: قَسَم
entries.definitionHtml:
قَسَم qasam [n.] oath

(56:76) وَإِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٌ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ and it is a mighty oath, if you only knew.

entries.label: قَسَمَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَسَمَ qasama i [v. trans.] to determine, to share out, to measure out

(43:32) أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ are they the ones who share out the mercy of your Lord!?–We have shared out between them their livelihood in this life, and raised some of them above others in rank.

entries.label: مَقْسُوم
entries.definitionHtml:
مَقْسُوم maqsūm [pass. part.] apportioned, assigned, allotted

(15:44) لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَقْسُومٌ it has seven gates, to each belongs an allotted share of them [the inmates].

entries.label: مُقَسِّمات
entries.definitionHtml:
مُقَسِّمات muqassimāt [pl. of fem. act. part. مُقَسِّمَةٌ muqassimatun] those who carry out acts of apportioning

(51:4) فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا who apportion what is ordained.

entries.label: مُقْتَسِمِين
entries.definitionHtml:
مُقْتَسِمِين muqtasimın [pl. of act. part. مُقْتَسِم muqtasim] those who divide with others, those who take a share; those who divine, or seek omens

(15:90) كَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ like the [warning] We sent down for those who were selective in their beliefs [lit. take some parts [of the teachings]].

entries.label: يَسْتَقْسِم
entries.definitionHtml:
يَسْتَقْسِم yastaqsim [imperf. of v. X, intrans.] to seek to divide, to draw lots by means of the divining arrows (أزلام), (q.v.), either to decide upon a course of action, or to distribute what are supposed to be equal parts of a slaughtered animal

(5:3) وَأَنْ تَسْتَقْسِمُوا بِالأَزْلاَمِ ذَلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ and [forbidden to you] is to seek answers by means of drawing divining arrows–that is a heinous practice.
